title: DeepSeek’s WEIRD Behavior: The cultural alignment of Large Language Models and the effects of prompt language and cultural prompting

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with Hofstede's VSM13 international survey questions (modified for a third-person perspective) and comparing the models' calculated cultural dimension scores against the baseline survey responses of the United States and China to measure WEIRD (Western) bias.
Evaluating how the language of the prompt (English versus Simplified Chinese) alters the cultural alignment of the models' responses.
